title: Gallery
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>

docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/gallery. Drop GalleryRoot anywhere for the full editor, or compose with GalleryGrid, GalleryToolbar, and GalleryLightbox manually. Use useGallery for programmatic control inside any child component.
